lines: So. This is the chosen one.
The prophecy said a saviour from the two-legged world. It never said which two legs.
I shrank. I actually shrank. Mummy is going to kill me.
Your mother is the least of your problems, small human. Follow us, and stay off open ground.
What mountain is that? Blue, with a silver road up the front.
You carry a mountain to school? Every day?
Keep close in the tall grass. Things live in here that have never seen daylight.
He means earwigs. He is scared of earwigs.
Mummy calls these coat buttons. I used to pull them for fun.
And now one is taller than your whole house was yesterday. Life is funny.
Careful here. The shy plants fold up when you touch them, and whatever is standing on them comes down.
Like certain strategists when you ask them to fight.
My marble! I lost this last term. I searched everywhere.
Your people lose a great many things.
Half the colony is furnished with them.
Behold, the Red Pavilion. Raised by our ancestors in the Year of the Great Drought.
The Shrine of the Red Stone. Brides touch it for luck.
Aunty Bisi lost that at my cousin's wedding. She looked for it for a whole week.
Then Aunty Bisi has blessed a thousand marriages.
Pill bugs. Big ones. Stay behind me, chosen one.
They're just woodlice. We used to roll them into balls.
Today they will roll you into a ball. Pick up a stone.
The Brass Moon. Our queen was crowned on it.
One naira. Is that a great fortune in your world?
Home. Try not to trip in front of the Queen.
And let them get used to you slowly. Don't smile too suddenly.
Did he... did he just lift that? Over his head?
Stand tall where others crawl. I told you. I have always told you.
You said, and I quote, 'we are doomed'.
Remind me never to annoy him.
Sorry! I didn't know it would go that far.
A boulder. He is moving a boulder. With his hands.
Everything is small to you, chosen one. That is rather the point.
Daddy has been looking for this leak for two weeks.
Your father's leak is our water station. Please don't tell him.
The Crystal Tent. Pilgrims rest there on the long road.
It's a pure-water sachet. Somebody threw it away.
Pure? There is a snail living in it.
The Wooden Road. Don't look down, and don't fall in.
Then you built us a bridge. The prophecy never mentioned engineering.
Quiet now. The leaves here crack like bones, and something always listens.
It's a mango. A whole mango. I could eat for a year.
The flies got there first. They always do.
This is where the scouts stop coming back.
Those silk lines across the path. Touch one, and it knows.

pool: The chosen one cannot swim. Marvellous.
Water at our size holds on like glue. Stay on the stick next time.
Let us all pretend that didn't happen.
Are we waiting for rain, or...?
A chosen one who stands still is just a one.
I wonder if Mummy has noticed I'm gone.
